fields.description: Master switch — nothing is pushed or pulled while this is off.
fields.label: Enable SAP Integration

fields.description: e.g. https://sap-server:50000/b1s/v1
fields.label: Service Layer URL

fields.description: Stamped when the integration is first enabled. 'Send Pending to SAP' only auto-sends never-attempted documents created on or after this date.
fields.label: Go-Live Date

fields.description: Comma-separated SAP ItemsGroupCode list. Leave empty to sync all sales items.
fields.label: SAP Item Group Codes

fields.description: Pull active SAP VAT codes into the Tax Mapping table below.
fields.label: Sync Tax Codes

fields.description: Ensure every SAP currency exists and is enabled in ERPNext.
fields.label: Sync Currencies

fields.description: Pull price lists, item prices, special prices, discount groups and period/volume discounts. SAP's order of preference is preserved: special price, then discount group, then period/volume, then price list.
fields.label: Sync Pricing

fields.description: Prefix for codes generated by 'Assign Customer Codes' (e.g. C -> C00001). SAP CardCode is limited to 15 characters.
fields.label: Customer Code Prefix

fields.description: Re-sync master data automatically. Each master keeps its own interval below, so the cheap ones can run often without dragging the expensive ones with them. Off means master data only moves when you press its button.
fields.label: Auto-sync Master Data

fields.description: How often items are re-synced. The most expensive master: every sales item with its UoM groups. Blank or 0 means 5.
fields.label: Items Every (Minutes)

fields.description: How often customers are re-synced, including which sales person SAP has them on. Blank or 0 means 5.
fields.label: Customers Every (Minutes)

fields.description: How often SAP VAT codes are re-read into the Tax Mapping table. A handful of rows, so cheap. Blank or 0 means 5.
fields.label: Tax Codes Every (Minutes)

fields.description: How often SAP currencies are checked. A handful of rows, so cheap. Blank or 0 means 5.
fields.label: Currencies Every (Minutes)

fields.description: How often price lists, item prices and special prices are re-synced. Expensive: it walks every item's price on every list. Blank or 0 means 5.
fields.label: Pricing Every (Minutes)

fields.description: When a Sales Order reaches SAP. On Submit sends it the moment it is submitted. Manual Only sends nothing automatically — use the 'Send to SAP' button on the order, for teams that confirm an order before it becomes an order in SAP. Off never sends it.
fields.label: Send Sales Orders

fields.description: Van stock requests (Material Request → SAP Inventory Transfer Request).
fields.label: Push Stock Transfer Requests

fields.description: Field Expenses post to SAP as Journal Vouchers when the Journal Entry is created.
fields.label: Push Expenses as Journal Vouchers

fields.description: For invoices that carry no ERPNext tax rows: tick if the price already includes VAT. The gross price is then sent to SAP, which derives the VAT itself, so both documents show the same total. Invoices that do carry tax rows are read from the document and ignore this.
fields.label: Prices Include Tax

fields.description: Fallback only. Payments post to the SAP G/L Account set on the ERPNext account the money went into; this is used when that account has no code yet.
fields.label: SAP Cash G/L Account Code (Fallback)

fields.description: The Sales Pro app creates these as drafts and never comes back to submit them. Turn a document on here and it is submitted the moment it is created — which is also what sends it to SAP. A submitted document can no longer be edited, only cancelled and amended, so leave a document off if anyone corrects it before submitting. These two work whether or not the SAP integration above is switched on.
fields.label: Auto Submit (Documents Created as Drafts)

fields.description: Off: orders arrive as drafts and someone submits them. From the App Only: orders from Sales Pro are submitted on arrival, while orders typed in the desk stay drafts. App and Desk: everything is submitted on creation. Submitting is what triggers 'Send Sales Orders' above.
fields.label: Auto-Submit Sales Orders
fields.options:
Off
From the App Only
App and Desk

fields.description: Same, for van stock requests. Submitting one sends it to SAP as an Inventory Transfer Request straight away, so a request whose warehouse is missing or unmapped will submit and then fail its push. Van returns are left alone unless the box opposite is ticked.
fields.label: Auto-Submit Material Requests
fields.options:
Off
From the App Only
App and Desk

fields.depends_on: eval:['From the App Only', 'App and Desk'].includes(doc.auto_submit_sales_orders) || ['From the App Only', 'App and Desk'].includes(doc.auto_submit_material_requests)
fields.description: Leave OFF. The document is then submitted a moment later, in the background, so the salesman's phone is not left waiting on the SAP call that submitting triggers (SAP is given 25 seconds to answer). Tick it only if the desk must show the document as submitted the instant it is saved — that adds SAP's response time to every save.
fields.label: Submit In the Same Request

fields.description: Van returns are left as drafts because the app creates them that way on purpose, and the permanent-return flow expects a manager to approve them first. Tick this only if returns should be submitted on arrival too.
fields.label: Also Auto-Submit Van Returns

fields.description: Every 5 minutes, SAP transfers into mapped van warehouses are mirrored as submitted Stock Entries.
fields.label: Pull Van Transfers

fields.description: SAP user field that carries the ERPNext document name onto the transfer request, e.g. MAT-MR-2026-00009. Because SAP copies it to the Stock Transfer, the pull can find exactly the transfers that came from here — no DocEntry, and it works where a flag added only to the request does not. This is the preferred route; leave empty to fall back to the van flag or a recent scan.
fields.label: Integration Number UDF (SAP)

fields.description: SAP user field that marks a transfer as van stock. It is set on every transfer request pushed from here, and the pull fetches transfers by it instead of by DocEntry — so stock arrives without anyone entering a DocEntry. Leave EMPTY to fall back to the DocEntry high-water mark.
fields.label: Van Request UDF (SAP)

fields.description: The value written to that field, and matched when fetching (e.g. Yes, or Y).
fields.label: Van Request UDF Value

fields.description: How often to check SAP, in seconds. Frappe's scheduler only fires once a minute, so anything below 60 makes that job poll repeatedly within its minute — 15 means a transfer posted in SAP appears here within about 15 seconds. The job holds a worker while it polls; set 60 for a single check per minute.
fields.label: Pull Interval (Seconds)

fields.description: How many of SAP's most recent transfers to examine each run when the van flag is not available. Anything targeting a van warehouse and not already pulled is brought in, so nothing gets stranded.
fields.label: Transfers to Scan

fields.description: Material Receipt: stock appears directly in the van warehouse. Material Transfer: moves from the source warehouse (needs ERPNext stock there).
fields.label: Receipt Mode

fields.description: Used in both directions when a document does not name a source: the warehouse van stock is transferred FROM when pushing a stock request to SAP, and the source for pulled transfers in Material Transfer mode. Must also appear in the Warehouse Mapping below.
fields.label: Default Source Warehouse

fields.description: Set once when the pull first runs, so enabling the integration does not replay SAP's whole transfer history. Transfers above it are pulled; it does NOT advance, so nothing can be stranded behind it. Lower it to reach further back.
fields.label: Start From DocEntry

fields.description: For order selling, where SAP raises the paperwork: the order goes to SAP, SAP delivers and invoices it, and SAP takes the money. These bring the invoice and the payment back so ERPNext shows what each customer owes. Anything that started in ERPNext is recognised and never pulled back as a duplicate. Runs hourly, and on the 'Pull SAP Documents' button.
fields.label: Document Pull (SAP → ERPNext)

fields.description: Invoices raised in SAP become submitted Sales Invoices here. Line prices come across net and the VAT is added from the Tax Mapping below, so an unmapped VAT group gives an invoice for the wrong money — the log says so when the totals disagree.
fields.label: Pull Invoices Raised in SAP

fields.description: Customer payments taken in SAP become submitted Payment Entries here, allocated against the invoices SAP applied them to. The bank or cash account is found by its SAP G/L code, so set 'SAP G/L Account' on the ERPNext account the money lands in.
fields.label: Pull Payments Taken in SAP

fields.description: How often to ask SAP whether a new invoice or payment exists, in seconds. Asking is cheap — one row, not a page of documents — so only a genuinely new document turns into a fetch. 60 checks once a minute; lower it for closer to live.
fields.label: Document Check Interval (Seconds)

fields.description: Documents dated before this are ignored, so switching the pull on does not drag in years of SAP history. Empty means the Go-Live Date above.
fields.label: Pull Documents From

fields.description: Leave OFF. In this flow SAP's delivery note is what takes the goods out of stock, so a pulled invoice that also moved stock would relieve the same goods twice. Tick it only where SAP invoices without delivering first.
fields.label: Pulled Invoices Move Stock

fields.description: Highest SAP invoice DocEntry handled by the live sync. Set automatically on the first run to whatever SAP already had, so switching on does not import years of history. Lower it to reach further back.
fields.label: Live Sync From Invoice DocEntry

fields.description: The same mark for payments. It advances only past documents that were imported or permanently skipped — one that failed for a fixable reason holds it, and is retried, so nothing is stranded behind it.
fields.label: Live Sync From Payment DocEntry

fields.description: Filled by 'Sync Taxes'. Link each SAP code to the ERPNext Sales Taxes template it corresponds to — pushed invoice lines then carry the SAP VatGroup.
fields.label: Tax Mappings
